{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Fangzar.jpg|thumb|An example of a Sern Prime topknot]]
A '''Sern Prime topknot''' was a hairstyle from [[Sern Prime/Legends|Sern Prime]] that consisted of long hair gathered at the top of the head.<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> It was a status symbol among the inhabitants of Sern Prime.<ref name="ROTS Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook]]''</ref> Sern Prime's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]], had such a topknot.<ref name="ROTSVD" />
